items.reason: This describes stale denials persisting after access is granted until the denial-cache TTL expires. None of the golden issues describes this problem; #05 concerns repeated DB reloads for distinct denied resources.
The unescaped underscore separators allow different name/parent pairs to share a denial-cache key, incorrectly denying another resource.
The test seeds the permission cache with false, so it passes even without the denial-cache short-circuit.
The comment identifies the same denial-cache key collision between different name/parent pairs caused by underscore concatenation.
The comment identifies the same false permission-cache seed that prevents the test from verifying the denial-cache short-circuit.
